title: The human eye
author: StopAtLoD
selftext:
Started trading a long time ago so not gonna argue with anyone who thinks they're gods gift to the trading community in a reddit thread, if this post isn't for you move on. 

Momentum swing trader here, heavily influenced by qullamaggie, zanger, minervini, weinstein, o neil, etc

Long term profitability achieved not looking for trading advice just wanted to share something I've built. 

I've said for a long time the human eye is one of the most useful tools a trader can develop. It’s incredibly difficult to quantitate parameters around a visual skillset. In my nearly a decade of experience I've never seen it done. 

But I think I might be getting close, with AI and quantitative parameters I've created a hybrid formula that attempts to mimick the human eye while also using quantitative rules to help filter noise.  

Pretty impressed with it. The entire goal of the formula is to create a compression score on the highest ADR most liquid momentum leaders. Friday's close it had $SKYQ as the #1 compressed stock in my universe of stocks. 

Which is incredible because of all the stocks I shifted through was the only one with an actionable set up.

Anyone interested in this?
